text: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens, aged 18 or above (by June 15, 2022) and in good physical and mental conditions to perform successfully in an academic program in a foreign country. 2. Compliance with Chinese laws and university regulations; Record of academic excellence. 3. The applicant must be: A high school graduate and no more than 25 when applying for the undergraduate programs. 4. Chinese proficiency certificate. (Required for Chinese taught programs). HSK4 certificate or above for undergraduate programs.
